confederation.confederation_name: Confederation of North, Central America and Caribbean Association Football
confederation.region_description: North America, Central America and Caribbean
confederation.qualification_summary: Canada, Mexico, and the United States qualified automatically as hosts. The remaining 32 FIFA-affiliated CONCACAF teams played a first round, second round group stage, and third round final group stage. Third-round group winners qualified directly; the two best runners-up advanced to the inter-confederation play-offs.

rounds.description: Canada, Mexico, and the United States qualified automatically as co-hosts.
Bottom four CONCACAF entrants played two-legged ties. Winners advanced to the second round.
Thirty teams in six groups of five. Each team played four matches. Group winners and runners-up advanced to the third round.
Twelve teams in three groups of four played home-and-away. Group winners qualified for the World Cup; two best runners-up advanced to the inter-confederation playoffs.
Jamaica and Suriname entered FIFA inter-confederation play-offs. Both were eliminated; no additional CONCACAF teams qualified through the playoff tournament.

groups.notes: Top two runners-up advanced to inter-confederation play-offs.

playoff_ties.tie_name: Anguilla vs Turks and Caicos Islands
playoff_ties.notes: Anguilla advanced to Second Round Group F on penalties.

playoff_ties.tie_name: U.S. Virgin Islands vs British Virgin Islands
playoff_ties.notes: British Virgin Islands advanced to Second Round Group E on penalties.
Bolivia came back to beat Suriname 2-1 in the inter-confederation playoff semifinal.
Jamaica beat New Caledonia 1-0 in the inter-confederation playoff semifinal.
DR Congo defeated Jamaica 1-0 after extra time; Jamaica was eliminated.
